reason: This plugin is primarily an external-services integration connector that links DSH with messaging platforms (initially WeChat via Claw/iLink, with QQ/WeCom planned), as shown by its package metadata declaring a DSH plugin bundle/client and README sections describing platform adapters, message routing, settings page, and command-driven session workflows. It focuses on bridging platform messages to DSH agents and returning replies, with additional media handling for audio/files and lifecycle/networked connector behavior.

summaries.zh: EveryConnect 是一个 DSH 插件，用于将微信 Claw/iLink 等平台消息接入 DSH，并通过设置页与命令菜单实现会话任务的连接和消息同步。
summaries.en: EveryConnect is a DSH plugin that connects messaging platforms like WeChat Claw/iLink to DSH, and provides settings plus command-based workflows to synchronize session conversations.

capabilities: 连接外部消息平台并在其与 DSH 之间转发会话消息
提供面向用户的任务/会话切换与控制命令
支持音频与文件类消息的下载并交由 DSH 会话处理
提供 Web 设置页用于连接器、二维码登录与凭据/会话参数配置
